chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was saying: 'The most superior of worship is chastity.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of worship in Shia Islam according to the Imams?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) attributes this profound teaching to Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib, elevating 'al-'afaf' (chastity/self-restraint) above ritualistic acts as the pinnacle of worship. This reflects the Shia emphasis on inner moral purity and sexual integrity as foundational to spiritual excellence, a concept deeply rooted in the Ahl al-Bayt's ethical framework. The narration underscores that true devotion is measured by one's ability to guard oneself from illicit desires, aligning physical discipline with spiritual devotion.
